steps.title: Library title
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/library.json with probes/ui_library.gd (cards library-title and library-title-fix): the title as the library at 1280x720 (Auto 1.40) and 1920x1080 window sizes, then 1280x720 for the 200-250 ft warning, focus, hover and Delete's confirm. The library is staged (seven maps of every source, one Bundled; no level folder is read or written); four real thumbnails are rendered first (the shipped Oak's Lab and three maps made here from a seed and a landform); the strip's sizes and Blender check are staged, and the thumbnails, the import and Replace files and the edited level live under user://_library_title_probe/ with the levels folder pointed there until cleanup deletes it.
